notes: δυνατόν carries the supplied it be under rule 68, the clause expressing no subject.

τὸ ἐξ ὑμῶν is split under rules 22 and 62: as much as on the substantival article headed on the nominal much, in … lieth on the preposition carrying the supplied lexical verb, you on the pronoun. Keeping the whole frame on the article remains defensible and the unit note records it.
εἰρηνεύοντες → be at peace heads on peace, the meaning-bearing complement (rule 17).
